name: Commercial Lighting
metaTitle: Commercial Lighting in Broward County | Ghost Crown
metaDescription: Sign repair, parking lot pole lights, and building lighting for South Florida businesses. Licensed crew with our own bucket truck. Book a site visit today.
intro: When your sign goes dark or half the parking lot disappears at night, your property says the wrong thing about your business. Our licensed crew repairs and installs sign lighting, parking lot pole lights, and building lighting across South Florida, with our own bucket truck on the road. You get one honest price, and the lights come back on.

definition.heading: What our commercial lighting service covers
definition.body: Storefront and channel letter signs, parking lot and pole lights, building exterior and security lighting, and interior lighting for offices, retail, and warehouses. We troubleshoot, repair, retrofit to LED, and install new. And because we run our own bucket truck, high work happens on our schedule instead of waiting on a rental lift.

symptoms.title: A sign that is dark, flickering, or half lit
symptoms.body: Drivers judge an unlit sign in one glance, and it never flatters the business behind it. We diagnose the letters, the power supplies behind them, and the circuit feeding it all, then fix what is actually wrong.

symptoms.title: Parking lot lights that no longer come on
symptoms.body: A dark lot is a liability and a customer complaint waiting to happen. Pole lights fail at the fixture, the photocell, or underground, and we run all three down with our own bucket truck.

symptoms.title: Tenants or customers mentioning dark corners
symptoms.body: Entrances, walkways, and back-of-building areas that fall dark push people away and invite trouble. Filling those gaps is usually simpler than a full redesign.

symptoms.title: Lighting bills that keep climbing
symptoms.body: Old fixtures burn power and eat ballasts. An LED retrofit cuts consumption and maintenance both, and we tell you honestly where a retrofit pays for itself and where it does not.

process.title: The call and a walkthrough
process.body: You tell us what is dark or failing, and we look at the property with you: the sign, the lot, the building, and the panels feeding them.

process.title: One honest price
process.body: We forecast the work, including the lift time, and give you one number before we start.

process.title: Our crew and our bucket truck
process.body: Our own licensed crew does the work from our own truck, so the schedule is ours to keep, including overnight work when downtime matters to your business.

process.title: Closed out and documented
process.body: Where a permit applies we pull it in our own name and meet the inspector, and you get a property that looks open for business again.

benefits.title: Your sign sells at night again
benefits.body: The letters are lit, the name reads from the road, and the storefront looks like someone cares about it.

benefits.title: A safer, brighter lot
benefits.body: Working pole lights protect customers, tenants, and your liability picture at the same time.

benefits.title: Our own bucket truck
benefits.body: No waiting on rented lifts or a second contractor. High work happens when we say it will.

benefits.title: One crew for the whole property
benefits.body: The same licensed crew that relights your sign can service the panels, meters, and wiring behind it.

localSections.heading: South Florida is hard on outdoor lighting
localSections.body: Heat, humidity, salt air, and summer storms corrode fixtures, connections, and photocells faster here than almost anywhere. Storm season also finds every weak splice in a parking lot circuit. We install and repair with materials rated for this climate, so the fix holds through more than one season.

localSections.heading: Plazas, offices, and property managers
localSections.body: Broward County runs on strip plazas, professional offices, and managed properties, and their lighting is a first impression that never sleeps. We work with owners and property managers on one-time repairs and on regular maintenance, and where sign or site lighting work needs a permit, we pull it in our own name and close it out clean.

guide.title: The honest guide to commercial lighting in South Florida

sections.heading: Sign lighting: what actually fails
sections.body: A dark channel letter is usually one of three things: the LED modules or neon inside the letter, the power supplies feeding a section, or the circuit and time clock behind the wall. Replacing letters one part at a time without finding the real fault is how a sign ends up half lit again in a month. We diagnose from the breaker to the letter face, fix the actual failure, and leave the whole sign on one healthy, controlled circuit.

sections.heading: Parking lot and pole lights
sections.body: Pole lights live a hard life: photocells cloud over, fixtures fill with water, and the underground runs feeding them corrode at the connections. A lot that has gone half dark is rarely a coincidence, it is one shared fault working its way down a circuit. Our bucket truck reaches the heads, and our diagnosis reaches the wiring underneath, which is the part most handymen cannot touch. Bright, even light in a lot is a safety measure and an insurance conversation, not a luxury.

sections.heading: LED retrofits, honestly
sections.body: LED retrofits are usually worth it for commercial lighting that runs every night, because the savings come from both the meter and the maintenance you stop paying for. They are not magic. A retrofit on fixtures that rarely run, or on poles that need structural work anyway, may not pay back the way a brochure promises. We look at your actual run hours and your actual fixtures, and tell you plainly which retrofit earns its keep.

faqs.question: Can you repair a channel letter storefront sign?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is work we do with our own bucket truck, letters, power supplies, wiring, and the circuit behind the wall. We recently brought a preschool's full storefront sign from dark and damaged back to fully lit at night. If your sign is half lit or dead, we will diagnose the actual fault instead of just swapping parts.

faqs.question: Do you handle parking lot pole lights?
faqs.answer: Yes. We service the fixture heads from our own bucket truck and chase faults in the photocells, contactors, and underground wiring that feed the poles. A half-dark lot usually has one real cause, and finding it is the difference between a repair that lasts and one you pay for every few months.

faqs.question: Can you put our property on a maintenance schedule?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plazas and managed properties do best with lighting checked on a rhythm rather than after complaints. We can walk the property at night, keep the signs and lot at full strength, and flag anything electrical that deserves attention before it becomes a failure. One crew, one contact, no surprises.

faqs.question: Do you do interior lighting for offices and warehouses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Office, retail, and warehouse lighting, from failed ballasts and flickering bays to full LED retrofits, is all in our lane. We work around your business hours, including nights when downtime matters, and give you one honest price for the scope before we start.
